mutable_tool_drift.review_note: Parent reports post-run change was limited to link diagnostics; historical pin is preserved without repinning.

review_limits: Historical 50F6 communal producer identity and allocation order remain unknown.
No extent is inferred from address gaps; a compiler fixture tests the proposed source type only.
10CC array capacity is unknown beyond one element, index zero.
The five SaveRec byte spans do not prove other fields saved or arbitrary malformed input handling.
Signedness and pointer depth are source-semantic claims; COMDEF width alone cannot establish them.
Gameplay ranges, pointer targets, initialization lifecycle and save/load robustness remain open.
10CC scalar Handle ownership is consistent with root producer; S16 uses only element zero. Capacity above one is not established.

10E2 source declaration states char far * far * far (two pointer levels, both far, with far storage) and producer stores f_171C_1A9E result; the historical UIPDPOWN control changes the explicit outer far qualifier, not the count of pointer operators. Both compile to the same 4-byte COMDEF shape.

1092 writes four separate balloon arrays after a >=6 upper guard and increments; there is no lower-bound guard in this producer, and initial-state/reset reachability is not proved here. Array owners/extents are a separate review.
No admission, canonical edit, production edit, or historical producer/order claim is made.
